Gantry keyboard jog

Connect both boards, then press an arrow key or hold an on-screen arrow. Hold arrows to accelerate; combine X and Y arrows to move diagonally. Release either arrow to slow that axis. Opposite arrows cancel on the same axis.

GOTO starts X and Y together in half steps, ramps toward the target speed above, and picks acceleration automatically. Short moves may finish before reaching that speed. Positions use commanded steps from this power-on session; they do not measure the gantry or track manual movement. Save only while stopped. Board restarts invalidate saved positions.

No homing or travel limits. Stay clear of the ends. Direction depends on wiring; physical distance is uncalibrated. Focus loss, connection loss and faults stop immediately. Coils release when stopped. Half stepping alternates one and two energized coils and can generate more heat.

Connect two different boards with updated responsive jog firmware. Arrow controls are available as soon as both boards are connected and healthy.
